**Source read:** `Inbox/needs-filing-2026-09-06T20-07-29.md` (2026-09-06 voice-note capture; GitHub revision 6910ca17).

**Main practical instructions (verbatim summary):**
- Single-user live service: deploy reviewed incremental changes to the existing production environment; test through the direct Zenod MCP connection and fix only bounded problems.
- Make undo easy: retain the previous immutable image + exact configuration, preserve data volumes/sessions, and keep a ready rollback command.
- Keep the change small; defer non-essential complexity removal.
- Maintain a durable deployments/upgrades spine leaf so supported procedures and learnings are reused.
- Do not introduce a new staging/provider setup when the authorized live environment is available.
- Verify the actual running container image and source revision (not merely desired config).
- Distinguish code rollback from data restore; use risk-based recurring backup policy instead of ad-hoc full backups.

No other 2026-09-06 deployment/rollback notes were found.
